correctness.rationale: The factorization proof completes any residual partial diagonal forbidden matching to D′, then uses k-1 edge-disjoint residual perfect matchings: at most |S|-|T|<=k-2 additional forbidden positions cannot intersect all. Thus all traces of supports |S|<=n-2 are exactly internal matchings, even nonmatching supports. For |S|=n-1 the unused row/column obstruction, either forbidden diagonal full completion or a negative edge forcing a diagonal assignment, excludes shattering. Inclusion-exclusion gives the crown rook polynomial. For m=O(sqrt n), full-board matching probability (n)_m^2/(n^2)_m has logarithm -m(m-1)/n+o(1), and off-diagonal conditioning changes it by at most m/n; monotonicity yields the supercritical limit. Independently enumerated ALL supports of sizes <=3 for n=2..6, every trace, and matched rook coefficients; this checks finite cases only. In n=2 VC dimension zero.
